scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: While the agent was efficient in its tool usage (recovering from initial path errors, making parallel calls), it fundamentally misdiagnosed the problem. The core analytical finding — that LrgWindowsAppManifest was not included in the solution build — was missed entirely, with the agent claiming the opposite. This cascaded into an incorrect root cause analysis. The project listing and error identification were competent, but the critical analytical conclusions were wrong.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
